title: Without an accounting integration the confirmation names the report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location has no accounting integration (neither QuickBooks Online nor AccountingHub).
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 2, for internal customer A, in status In Progress, with all lines done, not yet Complete.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Open work order 2.
  5. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  6. Click Close Work Order in the menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The rows show no account notes.
  • The sentence reads "This marks the work order Closed · Internal (Closed · No Charge). Parts cost, shop supplies and hours are available in the Internal Work Orders report."

Step 3:

  • The window closes.

Step 4:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 5:

  • The menu shows "Close Work Order".

Step 6:

  • The sentence begins "This completes the work order and marks it …".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-E4: “If the shop has no accounting integration at the work order's location, Close shows the confirmation without account notes, and the sentence of S3-R2 is replaced by "This marks the work order Closed · Internal (Closed · No Charge). Parts cost, shop supplies and hours are available in the Internal Work Orders report." (with "This completes the work order and marks it ..." when it is not yet Complete)”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Close without integration | "This marks the work order Closed · Internal (Closed · No Charge). Parts cost, shop supplies and hours are available in the Internal Work Orders report." | Sentence in the confirmation”
